name: MailJunky API
description:
The MailJunky API lets you send transactional emails, track user events, manage contacts, and build intelligent email workflows. All endpoints require API key authentication unless noted otherwise.

## SDK

Install the official SDK for the easiest integration:

```bash
npm install @mailjunky/sdk
```

```typescript
import { MailJunky } from '@mailjunky/sdk'
const mailjunky = new MailJunky({ apiKey: 'mj_live_xxx' })
```

For browser-side event tracking:

```typescript
import { initMailJunky } from '@mailjunky/sdk/browser'
const mj = initMailJunky({ apiKey: 'mj_pub_xxx' })
```

## Authentication

Authenticate by including your API key in the `Authorization` header:

```
Authorization: Bearer mj_live_your_api_key
```

You can also use the `X-API-Key` header. Public keys (`mj_pub_*`) are restricted to event tracking only.

## Rate Limits

All responses include rate limit headers:
- `X-RateLimit-Limit` - Requests allowed per window
- `X-RateLimit-Remaining` - Requests remaining
- `X-RateLimit-Reset` - Window reset time (unix timestamp)
- `Retry-After` - Seconds to wait (when rate limited)

## Base URL

```
https://www.mailjunky.ai/api/v1
```
